gloss: somewhat late; on the late side

definitions.gloss: somewhat late; on the late side; a bit slow
definitions.explanation: Formed from {遅|おそ}い plus the suffix め. Indicates being later or slower than average, but not extremely so — 'a bit late.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遅|おそ}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: Today I got up a bit late.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕食|ゆうしょく}→夕食：03006_yuushoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遅|おそ}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: We eat dinner at a somewhat late hour.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{混|こ}む→混む：02574_komu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{遅|おそ}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: Since the trains get crowded, I decided to leave home a little on the late side.

notes:
The suffix め attaches to an adjective stem to mean 'somewhat ~' or 'on the ~ side.' ⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧ (late) → {遅|おそ}め.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遅|おそ}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to leave a bit late
- {遅|おそ}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: a somewhat late hour
- {遅|おそ}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{昼食|ちゅうしょく}→昼食：01616_chuushoku⟧: a late lunch

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧: somewhat early — the antonym, formed the same way
- ⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧: late; slow — the plain adjective, without the softening め
